Schaeffer's broken-IPO study (source 9): ~+8.9% average 1-year return, -13% median at six months. Ladder: I keep a market anchor but cut its weight from 60% to 50%: my fundamental value now matches the corrected peer reconciliation, so it is less likely to be my own error, while the sell side at ~$292 (source 4) and the backlog I cannot fully underwrite still argue against putting the centre at $118. The 50/50 mix gives a median ~$131, P(>= $149) = 0.41, and I trimmed the far right tail (P(>= $372) 0.042 -> 0.032) for the Ritter PSR>40 evidence. P(>= $37) 0.98: ~$15.6/share of horizon net cash.
